tagline: Japan's largest banking group with global financial services operations
hero_kpi_rationale: Net interest income is a key indicator of a bank's performance. MUFG has recorded a significant increase in this figure over recent years, rising from $2.625 billion in 2024 to $3.088 billion in 2025, reflecting the expansion of lending activities.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from interest on loans and deposits
kpis.description: Net interest income is a key indicator of a bank's performance
kpis.signal: Increase in net interest income driven by lending activity expansion

kpis.name: Non-interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated from non-interest-related activities, including securities services, fees, and trading gains
kpis.description: Non-interest income is an indicator of the bank's business diversification
kpis.signal: Decline in non-interest income reflecting market volatility

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net income attributable to shareholders of Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group
kpis.description: Net income is a key indicator of a bank's performance
kpis.signal: Decline in net income due to higher non-interest expenses

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets of the bank, reflecting the size and scope of operations
kpis.description: Total assets are an indicator of the bank's size and complexity
kpis.signal: Growth in total assets reflecting expansion in lending operations

kpis.name: Return on Equity
kpis.explanation: Return on equity ratio, measuring the efficiency of equity capital utilization
kpis.description: Return on equity is a key indicator of a bank's performance
kpis.signal: Slight decline in return on equity linked to asset growth

kpis.name: Dividend Per Share
kpis.explanation: Montant total versé en dividendes par action sur l'année fiscale.

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Total annuel : dividendes versés + rachats d'actions.
kpis.description: Cumulative dividends + buybacks (2021-2025) in billions USD. Source yfinance cashflow.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.explanation: Part du résultat net redistribuée. >80 % = potentiellement non soutenable.

kpis.name: Net Interest Income
kpis.explanation: Revenu généré par les intérêts sur les prêts et les dépôts, représentant le cœur de métier bancaire
kpis.description: Net interest income is a key performance indicator for banking operations, reflecting the profitability of core business activities
kpis.signal: Growth in net interest income driven by expanded lending activities and improved rate environment

risks.title: Geographic concentration: economic dependency on Japan
risks.score_rationale: Risk positioned first in Item 1A with highly intensive language ('material adverse effect', 'significant uncertainty'). 64.5% of assets tied to Japan, 56.8% of domestic loans. Stable trend but major structural weight. Criteria: dominant position, high intensity, systemic exposure, direct impact on revenues (26.8% of interest income).

risks.title: Credit risk: deterioration of domestic loan portfolio quality
risks.score_rationale: Explicitly linked to geographic concentration (56.8% loans in Japan). Medium-high intensity language ('adverse effects', 'significantly increase'). Upward trend: mention of progressive BoJ rate increases since March 2024 and future rate hike risk. Criteria: concentrated exposure, rate sensitivity, impact on credit costs.

risks.title: Intensifying fintech and non-financial institution competition
risks.score_rationale: Major strategic risk in Item 1A ('competitive pressures'). High intensity language ('may further intensify', 'alternative services'). Upward trend: explicit mention of non-financial institution entry and technology development. Criteria: direct threat to commission revenues, client base erosion, required digital transformation.

risks.title: Operational risks: natural disasters and business resilience
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A with highly intensive language ('heightened risks', 'material disruption'). Stable trend but major structural weight for Japan-based institution. Criteria: geographic exposure (Tokyo), IT system criticality, potential impact on operational continuity, prevention/remediation costs.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks: sanctions, cyber attacks and complex compliance
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A with high intensity language ('increased complexity', 'significant financial, reputational and other losses'). Upward trend: mention of current geopolitical conflicts and sanctions imposed by Japan, United States, EU. Criteria: impact on compliance environment, heightened cyber risk, potential financial and reputational losses.

risks.title: Climate risks: energy transition and stranded assets
risks.score_rationale: Explicit risk in Item 1A with high intensity language ('material adverse impact'). Upward trend: mention of evolving regulations, changing market expectations, asset devaluation risks. Criteria: impact on loan and investment portfolio, rising regulatory compliance costs, goodwill impairment risks.

risks.title: Goodwill impairment risk on international acquisitions
risks.score_rationale: Explicit strategic risk in Item 1A. Goodwill of 558.2 Bn as of March 31, 2025. Medium intensity language ('may not achieve', 'impairment losses'). Stable trend but growing weight with expansion (Krungsri Thailand, Bank Danamon Indonesia). Criteria: exposure to political and economic instability, synergy realization risk, impact on earnings.

risks.title: Strategic dependency on Morgan Stanley alliance: rupture risk
risks.score_rationale: Explicit strategic risk in Item 1A with medium-high intensity language ('material negative impact'). MUFG holds 23.5% voting rights and approximately 521.4 M in preferred shares. Stable trend but non-negligible rupture risk. Criteria: dependency for securities activities in Japan, absence of operational control, impact on growth strategy.
